senses.gloss: (sec. r. of נ־שך; cmp. שׁוּכְתָּא) to become rust-eaten, rust-colored.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 8a:2-6">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>אם ישוך הנחש וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:11">Koh. X, 11</cite>) <he>אם … מְשַׁתְּכִין עליו כנחשת וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. omitting <he>עליו</he>) when thou seest a generation over whom the heavens are rust-colored like copper, so as to let down no dew or rain; (Ar. <he>מְשׁוּתָּכִין</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>רקיע שמְשַׁתֶּכֶת וכ׳ …</he>; ed. Pes. a. oth. <he>דור שמשתכין שמשותן</he> a generation whose suns are red-colored &c.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5).
